policy: Only a same-run spatially blocked holdout winner may be proposed for a weekly slot. No artifact in this registry meets that bar: A4_h41_union passed its own-fold screen and confirmation but fails the H34 slot-bar re-score (0.14597 vs 0.16402) and is G3-vetoed, and every other registered file is a reference or a failed arm. Nothing is slot-approved. The cross-fitted downloads exist because the previous single-fit artifact was defective (IR-29-ARTIFACT-LEAK), not because a proxy recommends submitting them. The recommended file format is the zero-outside variant because a strict whole-array range check rejects NaN.

files.gate_evidence: FAILED the H34 slot bar when re-scored on that protocol (draws 20/21): A4 mean DTI 0.14597 against a bar of 0.16402, worst fold -0.00920, SGMC positive on 0 of 4 folds (evidence/h41a4_h34protocol/summary.json, knowledge/28_h41a4_results_2026-10-03.md). Its own-fold gates did pass - screen (draws 28/29) +0.0073436 = G1, confirmation (draws 30/31) +0.0077283 = G2 - but the +0.0073 was measured against C0_base on H41's own folds, not against the best control on the slot-bar protocol. G3 also withholds promotion (SGMC 1 of 4 folds in both stages). DTI is a catalogue-gap proxy, not a competition score. Do not spend a weekly slot on this.
files.summary: Slip-rate/recency-weighted INGENIOUS Quaternary-fault corridor columns (H41) added to the habitat model, cross-fitted over 4 folds x 2 draws and applied to the full footprint, then the frozen emission. This file exists to replace a defective artifact, not to be submitted: re-scored on the H34 slot-bar protocol it reaches 0.14597 against a bar of 0.16402 and fails, and G3 withholds promotion on the SGMC secondary proxy. Its value is methodological - it is the first leak-free artifact build in this repository, and it is the honest control for future arms. The zero-outside variant is offered because it also satisfies a strict whole-array [0,1] check, unlike the NaN-outside file.
